title: CCXT Exchange Extraction Output
description: Per-exchange extraction output from ccxt_extract. Contains everything CCXT knows about a single exchange, organized into two layers: runtime values (QuickBEAM) and structural AST (OXC). Schema 3.1.0 (Task 73b) adds the runtime.request_headers field carrying per-exchange user-agent + default HTTP header overrides resolved from describe(). Schema 3.0.0 (Task 117, breaking) replaces runtime.markets with the compact runtime.symbols_index derivation and drops structure.parse_methods + structure.ws_methods (extractors retained; discovery files still written for internal Phase 12 / Phase 15 consumers). See SCHEMA.md migration notes.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers should check this before parsing.

ccxt_version.description: CCXT npm package version used for extraction.

_provenance.description: Required per-path provenance map (raw/derived/override). Required and non-null since schema 2.0.0 (Task 61c).

ProvenanceMap.description: Flat map keyed by RFC 6901 JSON Pointer strings into the payload. Values tag the source tier: raw (discovery passthrough), derived (assembly-time computation), override (priv/overrides/<id>.json).

ExchangeMeta.description: Exchange identity and metadata from CCXT runtime.

pro.description: Whether the exchange has WebSocket (pro) support.

country.description: ISO country codes where the exchange is based.

alias.description: True if this is a re-brand alias (e.g., huobi -> htx).

referral.description: Referral URL and discount, if any.

tier.description: Priority tier for this project — hand-curated in priv/priority_tiers.json, not extracted from CCXT. tier1/tier2/dex are the buckets we commit to deriving recipes for; tier3 and unclassified still get full raw extraction.

RuntimeData.description: Runtime values extracted via QuickBEAM JavaScript execution. Layer 1: what an exchange IS (configuration, capabilities, markets).

describe.description: Complete describe() output from CCXT runtime. Contains all configuration: api endpoints, has capabilities, fees, limits, urls, exceptions, features, timeframes, requiredCredentials, etc. May contain sentinel strings: '__undefined' (JS undefined values), '__function:<ClassName>' (JS function references with resolved CCXT error class names, e.g. '__function:ExchangeError'). Null for alias exchanges or when no usable describe data was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

symbols_index.description: Derived per-symbol spot/swap classification from loadMarkets(). Introduced at schema 3.0.0 (Task 117) as the compact replacement for the full runtime.markets snapshot. Consumers needing per-market price, precision, fees, limits, or exchange-native ids must call loadMarkets() at runtime — that was the only drift-safe path anyway. Null for alias exchanges, exchanges without cached market data, or when no usable markets data was assembled.

symbol_patterns.description: Derived symbol formatting patterns per market type. Consumers use these rules for symbol conversion (unified <-> exchange-native). Null when no market data is available.

url_templates.description: URL templates per API section, showing base URL, sample path, and fully resolved URL from sign(). Consumers derive path prefixes injected by sign() (e.g., OKX's /api/v5/, Gate's /spot/). Null for alias exchanges or when sign() fails for all sections.

testnet_urls.description: Derived testnet / sandbox URL catalog with {hostname} placeholders pre-resolved. See $defs/TestnetUrls for pattern classification.

request_headers.description: Per-exchange user-agent string and default HTTP headers, resolved from describe() at construction time after class inheritance. Always present (always-emit wrapper) — `user_agent` is null and `default_headers` is `{}` for the ~90% of exchanges that don't override. Introduced at schema 3.1.0 (Task 73b).

RequestHeaders.description: Per-exchange HTTP request defaults, resolved from describe(). Always-emit wrapper (no null at this level) — consumers read `user_agent` and `default_headers` without nil-checks on the wrapper. The base CCXT `Exchange` class declares `userAgent` as undefined and `headers` as `{}` by default; values here reflect describe()-level overrides after deepExtend with the parent class's describe(). Out of scope: User-Agent constructed at sign() time (e.g. bigone.ts builds `'ccxt/' + this.id + '-' + this.version` inside sign), and runtime header mutations like okx.ts setSandboxMode() injecting `x-simulated-trading: 1`. Both bypass describe() and are not captured here — see ROADMAP Task 73e for the proposed OXC-side follow-up.

user_agent.description: Resolved User-Agent string from describe().userAgent. Null when the exchange did not override (base default is undefined) or when the override resolved to a non-string value (e.g. `false` per the type union `{User-Agent: string} | false`). Coverage is sparse — roughly 10% of CCXT exchanges override (e.g. coinbase, htx, bybit, deribit set chrome-style UAs from `this.userAgents['chrome']`).

default_headers.description: Flat string-to-string map of default HTTP headers from describe().headers. Always an object — `{}` for the ~96% of exchanges that don't override. Consumers merge these into every outbound request before per-method overrides apply. Examples: coinbase ships `{CB-VERSION: 2018-05-30}`, gate ships `{X-Gate-Channel-Id: ccxt}`, alpaca ships `{APCA-PARTNER-ID: ccxt}`.

TestnetUrls.description: Testnet / sandbox URL catalog derived from describe.urls.test + describe.options.sandboxMode. Promotes the raw testnet signals out of the opaque runtime.describe blob so consumers read one canonical shape. Introduced at schema 2.4.0 (Task 100).

pattern.description: Classification: 'separate_host' when describe.urls.test is non-empty; 'sandbox_flag' when only describe.options.sandboxMode is present; 'none' when neither is present.

urls.description: Testnet URL map from describe.urls.test with {hostname} substitutions resolved. Shape preserved from CCXT (flat section map OR nested host → section map). Non-null only when pattern == 'separate_host'.

sandbox_flag_field.description: Name of the describe.options flag used to switch to sandbox mode (currently always 'sandboxMode' when present). Populated independently of pattern — may coexist with 'separate_host' (okx uses both a same-host URL AND a flag).

unresolved_reason.description: Non-null only when pattern == 'none'. Explains why no testnet data was derived.

SymbolsIndex.description: Compact per-symbol spot/swap classification derived from loadMarkets(). Keys are CCXT unified symbols (e.g. 'BTC/USDT', 'BTC/USDT:USDT'). Introduced at schema 3.0.0 (Task 117) as the drift-safe replacement for the full runtime.markets snapshot. Consumers derive market_count via map size; for price/precision/fees/limits/info call loadMarkets() at runtime.

spot.description: True when the source market carries spot == true or type == 'spot'.

swap.description: True when the source market carries swap == true or type == 'swap'.

SymbolPatterns.description: Symbol formatting patterns derived from market data. Keys are market types ('spot', 'swap', 'future', 'option') mapping to per-type pattern analysis, plus 'currency_aliases' from describe().commonCurrencies.

currency_aliases.description: Exchange-native currency code -> CCXT unified code mapping from describe().commonCurrencies (e.g., 'XXBT' -> 'BTC').

SymbolPatternEntry.description: Symbol formatting pattern analysis for a single market type.

id_structure.description: How the exchange ID is composed from currency codes: 'baseId_quoteId' (most common), 'quoteId_baseId', 'baseId_only', 'numeric', or 'opaque'. Null if no dominant pattern (below 80% threshold).

separator.description: Character between currency codes in the ID: '' (concatenated), '-' (dash), '_' (underscore). Null if no dominant pattern.

case.description: Case convention of the exchange ID. Null if no dominant pattern.

suffix.description: Constant suffix appended after the currency pair (e.g., '-SWAP', '-PERPETUAL', 'M'). Null if no suffix detected.

sample_count.description: Number of markets analyzed for this type.

anomaly_count.description: Number of markets that don't match the dominant pattern.

anomalies.description: Exchange IDs that don't match the dominant pattern (max 50). Consumers should use direct symbol->id lookup for these.

examples.description: Representative sample markets (max 3) showing the symbol-to-id mapping.

UrlTemplates.description: URL templates per API section. Keys are dot-joined section paths (e.g., 'public', 'private', 'public.spot', 'private.delivery'). Each entry records the raw sign() probe: inputs (api_param, http_method, sample_path) and output (resolved_url), plus a derived url_prefix when provably correct.

UrlTemplateEntry.description: Raw sign() probe for a single API section. Records what was passed to sign() and what it returned. url_prefix is derived (resolved_url minus trailing sample_path) only when provably correct — null for suffix-mutation exchanges (bit2c, lbank, zonda) and sign() failures.

api_param.description: Section identifier passed to sign(). String for flat sections ('public'), array for multi-level (['public', 'spot']).

http_method.description: HTTP method of the sampled endpoint passed to sign() (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).

sample_path.description: First endpoint path from this API section (used as sign() input).

resolved_url.description: Full URL returned by sign(). Null if sign() threw (e.g., private sections without credentials, or sections missing from urls.api).

url_prefix.description: Derived: resolved_url with sample_path stripped from the end. Null when resolved_url doesn't cleanly end with sample_path (suffix-mutation exchanges like bit2c, lbank, zonda) or when sign() failed. Consumers use this as the full URL prefix for the section.

StructureData.description: Structural data extracted via OXC TypeScript AST parsing. Layer 2: what an exchange DOES (code structure, method bodies).

class_info.description: Class hierarchy information. Null for alias exchanges without class entries or when no usable class info was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

methods.description: Method signature inventory (no AST bodies). Null for alias exchanges or when no usable method inventory was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

sign_method.description: The sign() method AST for request authentication. Null if the exchange has no sign() method or is an alias.

authenticated_sections.description: API sections proven to require authentication via checkRequiredCredentials() gates in sign() AST. Handles api === 'X' and api[N] === 'X' patterns. Sorted. Null when sign() absent; empty list when sign() exists but no checkRequiredCredentials() gates found. Some exchanges authenticate without checkRequiredCredentials() — use sign_method AST for broader auth detection.

sign_recipe.description: Map of section name -> SignRecipeRecord. Keys mirror structure.authenticated_sections (contract-test invariant sign_recipe_keys_match_auth_sections enforces parity). Empty map when sign_method is null or no authenticated sections were detected. Scaffolded in schema 2.2.0; Task 64 emits all-null records with unresolved_reason = "not_yet_derived". Tasks 65–69 populate derivation fields incrementally. Standalone copy at priv/schema/sign_recipe_v1.json (must stay in sync).

request_shape.description: Map of section name -> RequestShapeRecord. Keys mirror structure.authenticated_sections (contract-test invariant request_shape_keys_match_auth_sections enforces parity). Empty map when sign_method is null or no authenticated sections were detected. Introduced at schema 3.1.0 (Tasks 70 + 71). Pins per-section HTTP request envelope (verb, path template, body encoding) so consumers can construct the wire request without walking sign() AST.

handle_errors.description: The handleErrors() method AST plus exception mappings. Null if the exchange has no handleErrors(), is an alias, or no usable handleErrors data was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

interface_signatures.description: Map of API method name -> InterfaceSignature from abstract/*.ts interface declarations. These are the generated per-exchange typed endpoint methods (e.g., publicGetTicker, privatePostOrder). Null for alias exchanges, exchanges without abstract files, or when no usable data was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

_unresolved.description: Pagination calls where the target method name is a runtime variable (not a string literal). Each entry has target_method: null and containing_method set to the method body where the call was found.

pagination.description: Map of target method name -> [PaginationEntry] showing which methods use pagination and what strategy. Values are always arrays (multiple entries when branch-dependent variants exist, e.g. coinbase fetchAccounts V2/V3). Optional _unresolved key holds entries with variable method names. Null for exchanges without pagination calls or when no usable pagination data was assembled.

overrides.description: Method override analysis for derived exchanges. Null for root exchanges (those extending Exchange directly) or when no usable override data was assembled; check pipeline integrity stats to distinguish source gaps from expected nulls.

unified_endpoints.description: Map of unified method name -> list of interface method names called within that method body (e.g., 'fetchTicker' -> ['publicGetV5MarketTickers']). Multiple entries when the method branches by market type or API version. Alias/derived exchanges inherit parent mappings when they have no own unified endpoints. Null when no unified endpoint mappings were found (own or inherited).

request_defaults.description: Map of method name -> per-key default request body entries extracted from literal ObjectExpressions that flow into this.<httpVerb>() calls. Per the Honesty Rule: resolvable primitives emit kind='literal' with value set; non-literal expressions emit kind='unresolved' with a closed-vocabulary reason tag (the value is null). Methods with no HTTP call, pure delegation, empty literal body, or divergent multiple-call-site bodies are silently absent. Null when no methods produced extractable defaults.

RequestDefaults.description: Map of method name -> (map of property key -> RequestDefaultsEntry). Keys are method names as they appear in the TypeScript class (e.g., 'fetchTime'). Per-property keys preserve the exchange's own string-literal keys verbatim; computed keys surface as the synthetic key '_computed'.

value.description: The resolved literal value (string, number, boolean, null, nested literal object, array of literals) when kind='literal'; always null when kind='unresolved'.

kind.description: 'literal' means the value is a fully provable primitive or nested literal; 'unresolved' means the AST expression is non-literal and the value is null.

reason.description: Null when kind='literal'. Otherwise a closed-vocabulary tag: 'conditional_value' (ternary / logical expression), 'identifier_reference' (variable or member access), 'dynamic_construction' (call, binary, template literal, partially-literal object/array), 'computed_key' (key was a computed expression), 'spread_elaboration' (reserved for future spread tracking).

SignRecipeRecord.description: Declarative per-section signing recipe. Authoritative copy of priv/schema/sign_recipe_v1.json (kept in lockstep). See CcxtExtract.SignRecipe moduledoc and SCHEMA.md § Signing Recipe. All derivation fields are nullable: Task 64 ships every record with null derivation fields + unresolved_reason = "not_yet_derived". Tasks 65–69 populate fields incrementally.

crypto_op.description: Hash / signature algorithm. Populated by Task 65.

canonical_string.description: Per-verb map of canonical-string records. Keys are HTTP verb names (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH) when sign() branches on method, or the sentinel `*` when every verb shares the same canonical string. A single section may mix families (e.g. GET = hmac_simple, POST = hmac_with_body). Populated by Tasks 66a (HMAC-simple entries) / 66b (HMAC-with-body entries).

signature_placement.description: Where the final signature is attached to the request. Populated by Task 65.

auth_headers.description: Ordered list of auth-related headers (excluding the signature header itself — see signature_placement). Populated by Task 67.

nonce.description: Timestamp / nonce source and wire format. Populated by Task 67.

pre_sign_transforms.description: Ordered transforms applied to the canonical string, body, or resulting signature before going on the wire. Populated by Task 68.

unresolved_reason.description: Closed-vocabulary reason when derivation fields are null. "not_yet_derived" is the scaffold default. Must be null only when every derivation field above is non-null (enforced by Task 69).

patch_count.description: Three-Strikes counter (see CLAUDE.md). At 3, migrate the recipe to priv/overrides/<id>.json rather than continuing to stretch derivation.

RequestShapeRecord.description: Declarative per-section HTTP request envelope (Phase 11, Tasks 70 + 71). Introduced at schema 3.1.0. Companion to SignRecipeRecord — where SignRecipe pins how a request is signed, RequestShape pins what the request envelope looks like before signing: HTTP verb(s), path template(s), path-param substitution rules, body wire encoding, and Content-Type. See CcxtExtract.RequestShape moduledoc.

endpoints.description: Ordered list of endpoint records for this section, walked from runtime.describe.api[<section>]. Empty list is honest-empty (section resolves but contains no HTTP-method leaves); null when describe.api is absent or the section subtree is missing. Populated by Task 70.

body_encoding.description: Wire encoding of the request body. 'json' (this.json), 'form_urlencoded' (this.urlencode/urlencodeNested/rawencode), 'query_string' (reserved — not yet observed on priority-tier exchanges), 'none' (sign() never assigns body). Null when sign() is absent or the body assignment is ambiguous. Populated by Task 71.

content_type.description: HTTP Content-Type header value. Derived from Content-Type literals in sign() AST when present, else falls back to the canonical value for body_encoding. Null when body_encoding == 'none' (no body to send → no Content-Type) or when body_encoding is null. Populated by Task 71.

unresolved_reason.description: Closed-vocabulary reason when derivation fields are null. 'not_yet_derived' is the scaffold default. Must be null only when every derivation field above is populated (enforced by the request_shape_honesty_valid contract invariant).

patch_count.description: Three-Strikes counter (see CLAUDE.md). At 3, migrate the request_shape to priv/overrides/<id>.json rather than continuing to stretch derivation.

RequestShapeEndpoint.description: Single endpoint within a request_shape.endpoints list. (verb, path_template, path_params) triple covers what a consumer needs to dispatch one specific request inside the section.

http_verb.description: HTTP verb derived from the leaf method key in describe.api. Uppercased to match RFC 7231.

path_template.description: URL path verbatim from CCXT's describe.api. {param} placeholders preserved as written. No leading slash injection, no {hostname} substitution, no URL-prefix injection (URL prefixes belong in runtime.url_templates).

path_params.description: Ordered list of {name}-style placeholders extracted from path_template. Empty when the path has no placeholders.

RequestShapePathParam.description: One path-template placeholder + its substitution rule. CCXT's this.implodeParams(path, params) always binds placeholders to call-args params, so source = 'params' today. Structured as a record (rather than bare string) to leave room for future binding modes without a schema break.

name.description: Placeholder name as written between {} in the path_template (e.g. 'order_id' for '{order_id}').

source.description: Which call-arg surface binds this placeholder. Today always 'params' (this.implodeParams).

reason.description: Optional rationale; required only when algo = "custom".

ws.description: WS class information. Null if no WebSocket implementation.

id.description: Exchange identifier (same as class_name for most exchanges).

type.description: Class type: 'rest' for REST exchange, 'ws' for WebSocket exchange.

extends_raw.description: Raw extends value from AST (may be an import alias, e.g., 'binanceRest').

extends_resolved.description: Resolved parent class name (e.g., 'binance' after alias resolution).

method_count.description: Number of methods defined in this class.

methods.description: List of method names defined in this class.

method_details.description: Per-method metadata (name, async, param count, statement count).

ws.description: WS method signatures. Null if no WebSocket implementation.

return_type.description: TypeScript return type annotation, if present.

InterfaceSignature.description: Typed API method signature from abstract interface declaration. Has name, params, and return type but no method body (unlike MethodAST).

params.description: Parameter list with names and TypeScript type annotations.

MethodAST.description: Complete method with full ESTree AST body. Used for sign(), handleErrors(), parse*(), watch*(), handle*(), and override methods.

body.description: Complete ESTree BlockStatement AST. Preserves all node types, position info (start/end byte offsets), and nested structure.

ASTNode.description: ESTree AST node. Shape varies by node type. Always has 'type' field. Position info via 'start'/'end' byte offsets. Permissive schema — ESTree nodes are too varied to enumerate exhaustively.

start.description: Start byte offset in source file.

end.description: End byte offset in source file.

HandleErrorsData.description: handleErrors() method AST plus exception mappings from describe().

oneOf.description: Exception mappings from describe().exceptions. Keys include 'broad' and 'exact' plus market-type-specific keys (e.g., 'spot', 'inverse', 'linear', 'option'). Values are objects mapping error strings to error class names.

exceptions.description: Exception mappings from describe().exceptions. Null if not available.

oneOf.description: HTTP status code -> error class name mapping.

http_exceptions.description: HTTP exception mappings from describe().httpExceptions. Null if not available.

error_code_fields.description: Derived from handleErrors() AST: all this.safeString/safeString2/safeValue calls that extract error codes and messages from API responses. Each entry records the object, field name, safe* method used, and alternate field (for safeString2).

throw_dispatches.description: Derived from handleErrors() AST: one entry per this.throwExactlyMatchedException / throwBroadlyMatchedException call. Each entry records which helper was called, the normalized exceptions-map source (exceptions/exceptions.exact/exceptions.broad/by_url.exact/by_url.broad/other), a raw string rendering of the source expression (anti-rot hatch), the resolved safe* binding for the lookup variable (arg[1]), and the unique resolved safe* binding referenced anywhere in the message expression (arg[2]) when one can be proven.

ThrowDispatchEntry.description: A single this.throw{Exactly,Broadly}MatchedException dispatch in handleErrors(). Pairs the exceptions-map source with the safe* binding that feeds the lookup argument, and with the unique safe* binding referenced by the message expression when derivable, so consumers can reconstruct code/message pairings without re-parsing the AST.

exceptions_source.description: Normalized tag for arg[0]. 'exceptions' covers bare this.exceptions. 'exceptions.exact'/'exceptions.broad' cover both this.exceptions['exact'] and this.exceptions.exact shapes. 'by_url.*' covers this.getExceptionsByUrl(url, 'exact'|'broad'). 'other' is the anti-rot fallback — use exceptions_source_raw to disambiguate.

exceptions_source_raw.description: Compact string rendering of the arg[0] AST (always present). Anti-rot hatch so consumers can still inspect the original expression when exceptions_source is 'other'.

lookup.description: Resolved safe* binding for arg[1], or null when arg[1] is not a bound Identifier. Shape mirrors ErrorCodeFieldEntry minus roles/sentinel_values, plus method to save a cross-reference.

message_lookup.description: Resolved safe* binding for the unique lookup value referenced anywhere in arg[2], or null when the message expression does not point at a single bound lookup value.

ErrorCodeFieldEntry.description: A single this.safe*(object, field) call found in handleErrors() AST, with role classification based on how the extracted value is used. Roles are derived structurally from the AST: throwExactlyMatchedException usage → error_code (value used as exact-map lookup key, typically a short identifier like Bybit's retCode or OKX's sCode — not necessarily numeric). throwBroadlyMatchedException usage → error_message (value is the message string scanned for substring matches in the broad-map). === / !== comparisons → status_sentinel with operator preserved for polarity detection. A field that flows through both throw helpers in the same handleErrors() accumulates both roles.

object.description: The identifier name of the first argument (e.g., 'response', 'error', 'data'). Null if the first argument is not an Identifier node.

object_path.description: Derivation path tracing the object back to the response parameter. E.g., ['response', 'data', 'failure', '0'] means the object was derived via response['data']['failure'][0]. Null when the object is 'response' directly (trivial path) or when the derivation chain cannot be resolved.

field.description: The literal value of the second argument — the field name being accessed (e.g., 'code', 'msg'). Integer for array index access. Null if not a Literal node.

field2.description: For safeString2: the alternate field name (third argument). Null for safeString/safeValue or when not provided.

roles.description: How this field's value is used in handleErrors(). error_code: passed to throwExactlyMatchedException as the exact-map lookup key (dispatches to an exception class via `exceptions.exact[value]`). error_message: passed to throwBroadlyMatchedException as the string to scan for substrings of `exceptions.broad` keys. status_sentinel: compared against literal values via === or !== (see sentinel_values for captured literals and polarity). A field can have multiple roles when its value flows through more than one of these helpers. Empty array when the variable's usage is not structurally resolvable.

value.description: The literal value being compared against, stringified.

operator.description: The comparison operator used. Consumers can determine polarity: === with early-return means success value, !== with throw means success value (negated), === with throw means error value.

sentinel_values.description: Literal values compared against this field via === or !== operators, sorted by value. Each entry includes the operator for polarity detection. Null when the field has no status_sentinel role.

PaginationEntry.description: Pagination strategy and parameters for a single call site. Each entry includes provenance (containing_method, target_method). Strategy-specific fields (cursor_received, cursor_sent, cursor_increment, page_key) are present only for relevant strategies.

containing_method.description: Name of the method body where this pagination call was found (e.g. 'fetchAccountsV2').

target_method.description: Target method name passed to fetchPaginatedCall* (first argument). Null when the argument is a runtime variable rather than a string literal.

max_entries_per_request.description: Maximum entries per paginated API call. Null when not statically resolvable from source.

cursor_received.description: Field name in response to extract next cursor (cursor strategy only).

cursor_sent.description: Field name to send cursor in request (cursor strategy only).

cursor_increment.description: Numeric increment for cursor values (cursor strategy only).

page_key.description: Parameter name for page number (incremental strategy only).

OverridesData.description: Method override analysis for exchanges that extend another exchange. Grouped by REST/WS class.

rest.description: REST class override details. Null if no REST-specific override.

ws.description: WS class override details. Null if no WS-specific override.

OverrideEntry.description: Override details for a single class (REST or WS).

overridden.description: Map of overridden method name -> MethodAST. These methods exist on the parent and are redefined.

new_methods.description: Map of new method name -> MethodAST. These methods don't exist on the parent.

inherited.description: List of method names inherited from the parent (names only, no AST).
